glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形) – originally a carriage seen from above. In the oracle bone script, there were large wheels on both sides and a central shaft at the front. Unrelated to 倝 and 朝.
s_page_origin: From cursive script of 車; compare 東 → 东.
senses: [chē] wheeled device, appliance, instrument or apparatus
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 車; s_page_origin explains the simplified 车.
